description: The FavoriteBikes StormX is a fat tire e-bike built for riders who want traction, cargo capacity, and year-round versatility. Available through Costco Canada or directly from FavoriteBikes, it pairs 26" × 4.0" Wanda tires with a removable 46.8V 19.6Ah (917Wh) battery and a welded rear rack. The wide tires add grip and stability on loose surfaces such as snow, sand, gravel, and rough backroads, while the rack carries secured gear within the bike’s 330 lb / 150 kg total load limit. For riders choosing between a commuter and an all-terrain e-bike, the StormX prioritizes all-terrain utility over smooth-pavement commuting. Its 48V / 500W Favorite Smart System hub motor includes a built-in temperature sensor, and the LTWOO 8-speed drivetrain uses an 11–32T cassette for varied routes. In its Canada configuration, the StormX provides assistance up to 32 km/h. Why riders choose the StormX 26" × 4.0" Wanda fat tires for added traction and stability on loose, uneven surfaces. Removable 917Wh battery that slides out for indoor charging; a full charge typically takes 3–6 hours. Welded rear rack rated to 55 lb / 25 kg, with an integrated rear brake light for practical cargo use. Adjustable hydraulic suspension with lockout for rough roads and firmer pavement setup. Hydraulic disc brakes with an electric motor cut-off sensor. 1,600-lumen smart headlight with high/low beam and a dusk-to-dawn sensor. Smart display and app with color LCD, RFID entry, and Bluetooth connectivity. 330 lb / 150 kg total load rating for the rider and cargo combined. The StormX is one of several FavoriteBikes models available through Costco Canada. If your ride is focused more on commuting than loose terrain, compare Costco electric bike models or read our Costco electric bike Canada buying guide before choosing. Buy through Costco Canada or directly from FavoriteBikes on this page. FavoriteBikes supports the StormX with a 5-year frame warranty and 2-year coverage for the motor, electrical system, lights, and charger. Questions about setup or service? Text +1 (256) 291-1260 or email support@favoritebikes.com .
